items.title: Trump says FBI investigating Nvidia boss's affair with alleged Chinese spy
items.summary: The US president said the FBI is now investigating the affair. He said he spoke with Jensen Huang and asked him about the affair.

items.title: Nvidia shares tumble over investigation into Huang's affair with alleged Chinese spy
items.summary: The share price dropped wiped hundreds of billions of dollars from the value of Nvidia.

items.title: France accuses Iran of supermarket fridge hacking
items.summary: Tons of chilled and frozen food was spoiled last month as fridges and freezers in hundreds of supermarkets heated up.

items.title: Turkey steel factory blast kills at least 17 people
items.summary: Eyewitnesses say the explosion shook the ground, with one believing an earthquake had hit near the Habas Demir Celik plant in Aliaga.

items.title: Judge denies motion to dismiss Lindsay Clancy's murder case
items.summary: The ruling means the case can move forward, possibly with reduced charges in a new trial.

items.title: Republican congressman to force impeachment vote on Defence Secretary Hegseth
items.summary: The effort will likely fail, but Representative Thomas Massie wants to push Trump to fire Hegseth before Democrats can launch their own impeachment process.
